annotations.title: See frames from a post's last render

description: The frame sheet the phone uploaded with its last render of a post's video, shown to you as an image: check the cut, titles and captions. stale true means the edit changed since that render: ask for a new one with edit_render. For a link to the sheet, media_link with frames_media_id.
name: edit_frames
